items: ¼ cup rice or rice blend

steps.title: Boil the broth
steps.body: Bring **6 cups chicken broth** to a boil.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: Add **¼ cup rice or rice blend**, and cook until soft.

steps.title: Whisk the eggs
steps.body: While waiting, in a separate bowl, whisk **2 eggs** until frothy.

steps.title: Add the lemon
steps.body: Whisk **6 Tbsp fresh lemon juice** into the eggs.

steps.title: Temper the eggs
steps.body: When rice is cooked, whisk about **¾ cup of your hot broth/rice mixture** into the eggs, **2 Tbsp** at a time.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Then, with heat on low and whisking constantly, add the egg and lemon mixture to the broth and rice, and whisk until simmering.
